---
title: "Sites recomendados"
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Um cartão por site (data/sites.csv).
cartoes(sites, function(s, i)
  div(class = paste("cartao reveal", cor_de(i)),
    h4(s$nome),
    p(s$descricao),
    if (tem(s$url)) tags$a("Visitar »", href = s$url, target = "_blank")))
```
